change: Port the Sloppy platformer starter to Dewy, including value-based movement, tilemap collisions, camera, procedural art/audio and two project tests.
validation: Independent C bootstrap: 21 focused starter/new-project checks passed in 17.88s. Formatter, Ruff and git diff --check passed.
coverage: Native and wasm, default and release: landing, jump buffering, coyote time, no double jump, short hops, platform drop-through and upward passage, both slopes, solid wall, respawn, movement and independent saved values.
Coin collection only once, tween progress, saved coin values, map markers.
Generated project native software rendering and web build; two included tests run headlessly in both native modes.
Manual browser smoke: movement and held jump reached the first platform and collected its coin; Down dropped through it. No console or network errors.

timing_observations.note: Single compiler-reported observations, not paired benchmarks or general performance claims.

limits: Gamepad bindings are present but were not tested with physical hardware.
The software render and browser smoke use default builds; release model logic and headless project tests were exercised.
